messages:
tess: Quick note  we need a concise benchmark narrative for next week's launch. Focus: latency-to-cost tradeoff and practical caching wins. Need hero chart + 2 supporting visuals. cc @mike @anya

mike: Agreed. Proposal for hero heading: ' predictable latency. lower unit costs.' (lowercase stylistic option). Want two lead charts: scatter cost vs p95, and a stacked bar showing cache hit ratio impact.

anya: For audiences: PLG signup -> emphasize % cost savings; Sales -> emphasize SLA + fallbacks. We'll craft two microcopy variants accordingly.

zoe: Design plan: slide (1280x720), twitter card (1200x675), and preview gif showing cache_on vs cache_off. Colors: latency=royal blue, cost=copper. Accessibility checks on captions.

mike: Running bench job with mixed payloads and prefix cache toggled. Baseline roughs: p50~20ms, p95~95ms, p99~240ms. With cache p95 often ~45-60ms. CSV will include tokens->$ conversion.

benchbot: job 9021 started by mike. logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/9021 ETA ~1h

tess: Messaging options to A/B test on landing:
A) 'Half the bill, same responsiveness for most requests'
B) 'SLA-ready throughput with consistent tails'
Which to primary?

anya: A primary for organic channels, B primary for paid/enterprise nurture. We'll run quick landing A/B.

zoe: Mockups uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/bench_launch_alts. Leaving export notes and alt text drafts.

mike: Bench complete. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/9021.zip. CSV includes assumptions: seq_len=32, batch=8, quant=4bit. Attached PNGs: hero_scatter.png, cache_ribbon.png, tail_hist.png

tess: Great. Next steps: 1) finalize two hero lines 2) create landing draft + capture fields for inbound routing (interest, company size, infra). 3) schedule 20m copy review tomorrow 9:30

benchbot: Reminder: ensure art assets exported with transparent bg for partners.

anya: I'll write two email subject lines and 3 social captions after copy review.

zoe: Exporting gifs and square social variants now. ETA 30m.

tess: Thanks team 44D aiming for landing + webinar promo live by Friday.
